> 第11章 他归天了（第1页）
皇帝的心头一跳，那可不行，他可不想让太上皇活啊。
皇帝立即就呵斥了一声，“胡闹！你堂堂一国丞相的嫡长女，冲什么喜？”
晋王抑制着沉怒，太上皇弥留之际，这些人竟然还在这里叽叽歪歪！
“阿阅，她，她，”太上皇伸出颤抖的手，艰难地指向沈湘珺，“有造化”
这么半句话，却让沈湘珺狂喜，太上皇这是要让晋王娶她！
沈湘珺知道知道这个时候自己越是要稳住，晋王对太上皇至孝，只要太上皇的话，他一定会听的。
她很是虔诚地伸手压在床沿，低头叩在自己手背上。
她这会儿极度盼着太上皇好好活下来！
太上皇拉着他的手往沈湘珺那边移，虽然动作做得很艰难，但在场的人都看得出他的意思。
他这是要让晋王去握沈湘珺的手，这分明就已经是想要让他们成为一对的意思。
晋王紧握住他的手，“父皇保存精力，儿臣去带个人入宫！”
他从太上皇越发冰冷的手和越发涣散的眼神中，看到了太上皇生机的飞快流逝。
御医跪了满殿，没有一个人敢吭声，说明他们对太上皇的病情是真的束手无策了。
“皇上，”太上皇却紧紧握着他的手，似是回光返照似的，目光看向了皇帝，“你答应我，绝不伤害阿阅。”
满殿的人都在这里听着呢，即使没人，这种时候他也不敢说不啊。
“父皇，朕是兄长，护着幼弟还来不及呢，怎么可能伤害阿阅？”
太上皇的眼皮又搭了下去，“你若动手，我不饶你”
他的声音又渐渐低了下去，脸色明显地灰了几分，任谁都看得出来。
就连他这样诡异的怪疾，陆昭菱都说能治，也许，她能治太上皇？
在这一瞬间，晋王也不知道自己为什么会有这样的想法，但是只要有一分可能，他都得试。
“父皇？”皇帝一时没有管陆二是什么人，他身为天子，也瞬间看到太上皇的面色败了。
在这一瞬间，皇帝也慌了，有一种止不住的慌。
他虽然一直盼着父皇赶紧死了，他好继位，好当一个真正的皇帝，而不是做什么决策之前还得听听太上皇意见，做错什么还会被太上皇骂。但当这一刻真正来临，他又有一种害怕以后再无人兜底的惶恐。
太上皇虽然会骂他，虽然总是压着他一头，但真有什么处理不了的事，太上皇骂归骂，还是会教他帮他啊。
对外，他就还能是一个挺有治国才华的好皇帝。
晋王浑身冷意，在这个时候也只能退开，攥紧拳头看着御医挽救太上皇。
青锋刚才得了命令就已经疾速出宫去陆府。
刚重生，又替辅大夫驱除了死气，她精神亏空得厉害。

> Chapter 11 He passed away (Page 1)
The emperor's heart skipped a beat, that was not possible, he did not want the Supreme Emperor to live.
The emperor immediately scolded her, "Nonsense! Why are you so happy to be the eldest daughter of the prime minister of the country?"
King Jin suppressed his anger. When the Emperor was dying, these people were still here chattering!
"Ayue, she, she," the Supreme Emperor stretched out his trembling hand and pointed at Shen Xiangjun with difficulty, "There is good fortune."
Such a half-sentence made Shen Xiangjun ecstatic. The Supreme Emperor wanted King Jin to marry her!
Shen Xiangjun knew that he had to be more stable at this time. The King of Jin was extremely filial to the Supreme Emperor, and he would definitely listen to what the Supreme Emperor said.
She put her hand on the edge of the bed very reverently, lowered her head and tapped the back of her hand.
At this moment, she desperately hoped that the Supreme Emperor would survive!
The Supreme Emperor took his hand and moved it towards Shen Xiangjun. Although the movement was difficult, everyone present could see what he meant.
He wanted King Jin to hold Shen Xiangjun's hand. This clearly meant that he wanted them to become a couple.
King Jin held his hand tightly and said, "Father, save your energy, and I, my son, will bring someone into the palace!"
He saw the rapid passage of the Supreme Emperor's vitality from his increasingly cold hands and increasingly distracted eyes.
The imperial doctors knelt all over the palace, and no one dared to say a word, which showed that they were really helpless about the Emperor's condition.
"Your Majesty," the Supreme Emperor held his hand tightly, looking at the Emperor as if reflecting on his past, "Promise me you will never hurt A Yue."
Everyone in the hall was listening here. Even if there was no one, he would not dare to say no at this time.
"Father, I am the elder brother. It is too late to protect my younger brother. How can I hurt Ayue?"
The Supreme Emperor lowered his eyelids again, "If you take action, I won't spare you."
His voice gradually dropped again, and his face turned visibly gray, anyone could see it.
Lu Zhaoling said that even a weird disease like his could be cured. Maybe, she could cure the Supreme Emperor?
At this moment, King Jin didn't know why he had such an idea, but he had to try as long as there was a chance.
"Father?" The emperor didn't care who Lu Er was for the moment. As the emperor, he instantly saw the Emperor's expression defeated.
At this moment, the emperor also panicked, and there was an unstoppable panic.
Although he had been hoping that his father would die soon so that he could succeed to the throne and become a true emperor, instead of having to listen to the Supreme Emperor's opinion before making any decisions and being scolded by the Supreme Emperor if he made any mistakes. But when this moment actually came, he was also afraid that no one would tell him the truth again.
Although the Supreme Emperor would scold him and always put pressure on him, if there really was something he couldn't handle, even if the Supreme Emperor scolded him, he would still teach him to help him.
Externally, he was still a good emperor with considerable talent for governing the country.
King Jin felt cold all over, and he could only retreat at this moment, clenching his fists and watching the imperial doctor save the Supreme Emperor.
Qingfeng had just received the order and had quickly left the palace to go to the Lu Mansion.
She had just been reborn, and had expelled the death energy for the assistant doctor. She was very mentally drained.
